title: InterpreterNodeRegistry
description: Contract 4B (FlowDesk Chat V2). The universal interpreter's node registry. Each entry declares the node's execution kind, which LLM method(s) it may call (via LLMProvider only — CODEX-RULE-073), and the whitelisted tools it may invoke. The graph (not the prompt) defines the space of actions; tools not listed are forbidden for that node.

llmMethods.description: LLMProvider methods this node may call. Empty for deterministic/human nodes. A node with a non-empty list MUST have kind ∈ {hybrid, llm}.

tools.description: Whitelisted tool ids this node may invoke. Any other tool call from this node is a contract violation.

readOnly.description: True when the node may only use read-only tools (e.g. INFO_ANSWER). Guards against side effects in the KB/deflection branch.
